we give second-order approximation to the regret for the two-stage procedure of Mukhopadhyak and Duggan and show that our approximations are sharper.

(a) we give second-order approximation to the regret in estimating the mean of an Exponential distribution by a two-stage procedure, and (b) our approximations are sharper and our bias-corrected estimator is better than that proposed by Mukhopadhyaya and Duggan.

(1) the second-order approximations for the bounds for the regret given by Mukhopadhyyay and Duggam (2001) are not sharp; (2) we provide second-order approximations of the regret which are sharper than those given by them; (3) we also propose a bias corrected procedure which reduces the regret.
